verdict.rationale: Thoropass documents SOC 2 controls mapped into its Unified Controls through a SOC 2-to-Unified Control map, with a framework-controls view alongside them. It also covers policy creation and approval workflows, evidence requests auto-satisfied by integrations, and an audit run in one platform from scoping through final report. missing for 10: explicit evidence of distinct Type I vs Type II audit support, an explicit Trust Services Criteria control library or pre-built SOC 2 policy templates, independent/hands-on corroboration.
